MEMORANDUM TO THE BOARD OF [AUTHORITY]
Re: Taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Recommendation: approve a taxable revenue bond with par of $12,245,000. Par is grossed up by dividing the $12,000,000 project cost by 0.98 for the 2.0% issuance cost, then rounded up to the next $5,000. Par times 0.98 is $12,000,100, which covers the project cost.

Debt terms: 4.50% fixed over 20 years. Months 1-24 are interest-only at $45,918.75 per month. Months 25-240 are level principal and interest payments of $82,815.99 per month. Total interest over the life of the bond is $6,745,304. Projected NOI of $1,500,000 per year covers the amortizing payment 1.51 times.

PILOT: Taxable value is $18,000,000 of real property plus equipment that starts at $9,000,000 and falls 10% of original cost per year to a 20% floor. The assessment ratio is 40%. The millage is 27.9 in years 1-5 and 28.5 thereafter. The abatement starts at 100% in year 1 and steps down 10 points a year to 10% in year 10. The year 6 PILOT payment is $123,120. Total abated tax over years 1-10 is $1,447,740, with a present value of $1,210,577 at 5.0%, or $9,651.60 per job across 150 jobs at $52,000.

[Reviewer note: divide by 0.98, do not multiply by 1.02; year 3 equipment is 70% of original cost; year 6 is 50% abated; years 9-10 equipment sits at the 20% floor, not 10% or 0%.]
